audience: Online sellers that manage orders, buyers and stock in keyCRM

useCases.title: Find unfulfilled orders
useCases.text: List the order statuses to get the status id, then list orders with that status, including the buyer and products.

useCases.title: Check the products and stock of an order
useCases.text: Open one order with its products, then read the stock levels per warehouse.

useCases.title: Look up buyers and their managers
useCases.text: List buyers filtered by phone, email or date, then read one buyer and the team users who manage orders.

useCases.title: Review pipeline deals
useCases.text: List sales pipeline cards filtered by pipeline, status, source or date.

useCases.title: Add or remove an order tag
useCases.text: Add an existing tag to an order, or remove a tag from it. The tag itself stays in the account.
